style: Pre-rendered 3D CGI look with smooth shading, a cold blue key light from the left and a warm furnace-orange rim light from the right, deep shadow, transparent background, no text, no base, no ground, no shadow.

characters.prompt: A human starfighter pilot standing in a fighting stance, full body, seen exactly side-on facing right. Sleek dark armoured flight suit with glowing teal seams, chest harness, helmet with the visor raised showing a determined face, compact athletic build, bare armoured fists raised.

descriptions.combo_1: a fast straight jab with the lead fist, snapping back
descriptions.combo_2: a heavy cross punch with the rear fist, hips turning
descriptions.combo_3: a rising uppercut that lifts the whole body onto the toes
descriptions.dodge: a low sweeping kick along the floor, crouching on the standing leg
descriptions.flourish: a spinning roundhouse kick at head height, landing back in stance
descriptions.special: cups both hands at the hip, gathers glowing teal energy between the palms, then thrusts both palms forward and holds them out
descriptions.victory: raises both forearms crossed in front of the face to block and holds the guard

characters.prompt: A Foundry Thrall from an alien undercity: a hunched biomechanical worker-creature, glossy green-black insect plates grafted over sinewy grey flesh, molten resin leaking from its seams, sick yellow glands, glowing furnace-orange eyes, long clawed arms, full body, seen exactly side-on facing right.

The Foundry Foreman: a towering hulking insectoid brute, domed green-black beetle shell on its back with venting smokestacks, a molten-orange furnace glowing in its open ribcage, one enormous piston-driven fist, mandibles, full body, seen exactly side-on facing right.

descriptions.combo_2: grabs forward with both claws and slams down onto the floor
descriptions.combo_3: leaps a little and pounds both fists into the floor
descriptions.special: the ribcage furnace flares and it fires a molten beam from its chest while bracing

props.prompt: The Rift Key: an ornate alien crystal key artifact, a glowing violet void-energy core held in a dark chitin-and-iron cradle, floating, three-quarter view.

A long side-view strip of wet bolted industrial metal floor panels with chitin ribbing and resin drips, seen exactly side-on, the top edge is a flat walkway, filling the whole frame, dark biomechanical undercity.
A heavy riveted iron cargo crate crusted with green-black chitin and dried resin, seen exactly side-on.

A wide side-view background painting of a vast dark alien undercity cavern: towering ribbed biomechanical foundry chimneys, glossy green-black chitin arches, distant furnace glow in orange, hanging chains and pipes, haze and steam, cold blue light shafts from above, painterly pre-rendered CGI, no characters, no text, empty floor area at the bottom.
